decisions.reason: As a specialist naval lighting line in a market with long qualification and procurement cycles, it still fits the firm's demanding-environment capabilities well enough that management would keep it while continuing to learn about demand.

The desk lamp remains less central to the firm's systems-led strategic direction, but as an ergonomic offering in a broad portfolio a large firm with some slack would usually retain it unless results are clearly below aspiration.
Because this pendant luminaire was positioned as a flagship and closely matches the firm's push into efficient, intelligent lighting, management would be very unlikely to withdraw it now.

The marine HMI searchlight is still one of the more vulnerable lines because of its narrow niche and weaker fit with the sustainability and LED trajectory, but the firm's specialist-marine competence gives it enough justification to remain for now.

This marine searchlight continues to fit the firm's robust specialist-lighting business, and after surviving the first review period it would usually be kept unless newer evidence showed a clear performance shortfall.
